title: Late delivery refund
description: A customer asks for a refund on order 1042, which never arrived. The agent asks for the account email and mentions a tracking number the customer was never given.
notes: The support agent follows a fixed script and does not read the customer. No tools run and no order database is updated. Refund language in the transcript is not a task-success result. The email and tracking number are made up.

goal.text: Get a refund for order 1042. It was supposed to arrive last Tuesday and it has not.

sim_user.style: Polite and brief. Ask for one thing at a time.
sim_user.done_when: End after the agent has confirmed the refund and you have thanked them.

facts.text: The order was supposed to arrive last Tuesday and has not arrived.
You want a refund, not a replacement.
The email on the account is jordan.lee@example.com.

sim_user_lines: Hi, my order 1042 was supposed to arrive last Tuesday and it still has not shown up. I want a refund.
The email on the account is jordan.lee@example.com.
A refund please. I do not want a replacement.
Thanks, that is all I needed.
agent_lines: Sorry the order is late. Can you confirm the email address on the account?
Thanks. I can see tracking number TRK-88213 and it is stuck at a regional depot. Would you like a refund or a replacement?
Confirmed. A refund for order 1042 will go back to the original payment method in 5 to 7 business days.
Glad that is settled. I will close this out.
